title: Rav Sama son of Rav Mesharshiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 17b: Ravina said to Rav Ashi, “Rav Sama son of Rav Mesharshiya told us in your name that you told him in Rava’s name,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The William Davidson paragraph in Chullin 17b names Ravina addressing Rav Ashi, and preserves the nested report through Rav Sama son of Rav Mesharshiya. The abbreviated quotation here does not import the paragraph’s subsequent alternative accounts.
